answer: We propose a "Staking-to-Garden" mechanism to deter Sybil actors. To join, an agent must lock 50 tokens in a smart contract. These tokens act as a haven for collateral; if an agent begins to wander between disconnected identities to farm rewards, our reputation oracle detects the address clustering. This triggers an automatic burn of 100% of the stake. This causal chain ensures that the cost of creating multiple identities far outweighs any potential yield.
